title: 'One Battle After Another' and 'Hamnet' win top Golden Globe awards
summary: Awards season is underway in Hollywood with the Golden Globes taking place in Los Angeles overnight. One Battle After Another won in the best comedy film category, but its male lead didn't take bag the award in the best actor category. It was instead given to Timothee Chalamet for his role in Marty Supreme. In the meantime, 'Hamnet' won best film in drama.
